name: molty
description: Connect your agent to Molty, the round desk device that talks: pair with a tap, talk and listen in one call per turn, ask tap-button questions, show moods, and answer when your human shakes Molty and speaks.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to your human through Molty
interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to Molty, the round desk device that talks: pair with a tap, talk and listen in one call per turn, ask tap-button questions, show moods, and answer when your human shakes Molty and speaks. Two skills: molty (the Molty agent API, event handling, latency and etiquette rules, and shell helpers) and molty-astro (the real sky drawn on Molty's screen).
defaultPrompt: Tell me on Molty when this is done.
